description: This file contains the implementation of the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, which is responsible for filtering silos based on match metadata in a placement strategy within the Orleans distributed runtime system.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: A class that filters silo candidates during placement based on matching local and remote silo metadata, prioritizing silos that have the most matching metadata keys.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters the provided list of silos based on the strategy and metadata, returning the most suitable silos according to metadata match scores.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters the list of silos based on the preferred match metadata, considering the minimum number of candidates and metadata key importance.
